narrow_supported_copy.title: A 2000 Review Described the Scope and Sourcing Limits of Red Mafiya
narrow_supported_copy.description: On November 16, 2000, The New York Review of Books published Raymond Bonner’s review of Robert I. Friedman’s Red Mafiya. The review described the book as an account of Russian mobsters with criminal enterprises across countries and cautioned that the book had no notes, leaving some of its findings difficult to trace. This is supported context about the book and its review; the accessed sources do not establish a Trump connection.

blockers.detail: Neither accessed article documents a Trump action, statement, relationship, policy, or consequence. The supplied New York Times URL is a separate February 21, 2000 article about money laundering in Israel; it does not cite Friedman or Red Mafiya.
The frozen record points to a TrumpFile page dated 2000-05-01, but the supplied URL returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch. Its claim text and any connection to Trump could not be checked from that page.
The supplied Hachette URL returned HTTP 200 after redirecting to the Hachette home page, so it did not provide the specific book page.
